answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 33684 Country: India Title: Please clarify whether salah can be performed without inner garments (trouser), in a Masjid where carpet or mat has been spread? Question: Please clarify whether salah can be performed without inner garments (trouser), in a Masjid where carpet or mat has been spread? Answer ID: 33684 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1297/1297/M=1432) It is not known what do you mean by inner garment (trouser). However, if the parts whose covering is wajib are covered then salah shall be valid, otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
